label: Match Restore Lab
description: Optional lab/debug commands for match_restore — item-spawn timers, low-level item entity tools, manual match clock control, single-player state debug. Not used in a real tournament restore; requires match_restore to be loaded.

commands.name: spawnsec
commands.description: Manages item-spawn timer overrides for the current map.

commands.name: itemlab
commands.description: Low-level item-entity tools used while building a checkpoint (touch/respawn/inspect).

commands.name: matchtime
commands.description: Shows or sets the current match clock.

commands.name: restoreplayer
commands.description: Restores a single player's state from an exported snapshot.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the lab/debug command set on or off. Shared with match_restore's own enable flag.
